description: V3-C13 (superseded half). Receipt R-A (digest sha256:aaaa...) was superseded by receipt R-B, which carries superseded_receipt naming R-A; the signed status snapshot marks R-A SUPERSEDED and R-B CURRENT with a supersedes link. Reproducibility still says MATCH; the freshness dimension says SUPERSEDED and the default fail-closed policy rejects it. The successor R-B itself assesses CURRENT.
title: A superseded receipt re-verifies as MATCH but is REJECTED on freshness
